html:
Denis Mukwege is a Congolese gynaecologist who founded Panzi Hospital in Bukavu in 1999 and has treated tens of thousands of women who survived sexual violence in the eastern Congo's wars.

He and his staff developed methods to repair injuries from rape used as a weapon by armed groups in the Second Congo War and the Kivu conflict. He spoke out against the violence at the United Nations and survived an attempt on his life in 2012.

In 2018 he shared the Nobel Peace Prize with Nadia Murad, a Yazidi survivor of the Islamic State, for their efforts to end sexual violence in war. He ran for president of the Congo in 2023.
sum: Denis Mukwege is a Congolese gynaecologist who founded Panzi Hospital in Bukavu in 1999 and has treated tens of thousands of women who survived sexual violence in the eastern Congo's wars.
